construct: combined effect of all v0.4 ablation components and their interaction loss

input.description: Run the shared ablation benchmark manifest with ToolGuard, ContextBuilder, Signal Pipeline, and Hashline all enabled.
setup: Compare all_components against baseline and best single-component metrics

expectedBehavior: The all-components config produces comparable metrics and interaction_loss diagnostics without assuming additive gains.
passCondition: manifest_valid == true AND config == 'all_components' AND metric_schema_valid == true
failureImplication: The harness cannot detect component interaction regression before integration freeze.
relatedPaper: AHE: summed single-component gains may exceed combined gains; AEvo: evaluator isolation prevents reward hacking.
regressionRisk: All-components may perform worse than the best single component due to cross-component interference.
